Made for you

Same level. Different goal. Different path.

Your goals, your level and the topics you enjoy draw your path. Change your goal and your path changes too.

  • A roadmap made for youBuilt from your level, your goals and your favourite topics.
  • Lessons in roundsWords and grammar come in short rounds, each one building on the last.
  • 15 gamesHalf your roadmap is games, from A1 to C1.
  • Speaking and writing practiceSay or write your answer and get feedback right away.
  • Vocab BoxWords you mark "Practice again" go into the box and come back on your roadmap.
  • Page report (Plus)A report on what you learned each time you finish a roadmap page.
  • MessagesWrite to Farin in the app; he usually answers within a day.
  • English and SpanishOn the first screen you choose which language to learn.
  • Phone notificationsShort reminders; turn them off in Settings any time.
  • Speaking clubsLive groups every Thursday; book your seat in the Club tab.
Build my roadmap

Games

Half your roadmap is games.

The app has 15 games: big story games and quick ones, from A1 to C1. Half of every roadmap page is games, and every game is free.

Comic adventure · A1–B2

The Red Suitcase

You arrive in a small seaside town with one red suitcase. You choose what to say, and the story follows. You play the lead, under your own name.

Four albums, A1 to B2

  • A1WhitbyThe Camera
  • A2IstanbulThe Bazaar Key
  • B1VíkFire and Ice
  • B2TsugaruThe Silent Train

Learning Spanish? La maleta roja is set in Cudillero.

Meet the town

Most games are set in the same harbour town, so you keep meeting the same neighbours: in the café, on the street, on the pier.

  • Word BingoListen to the clue and tap the word on your card.
  • Build ItTap the word tiles to build the sentence.
  • Story HuntFind the words hidden in a passage from your story.
  • Say It BackListen to a line and say it back.
  • Listen & TypeListen to a sentence and type what you hear.
  • Mini CrossSpell the words you learned into a pocket crossword.
  • Word RushFlip tiles and match each word with its meaning.
  • Trap DashPick the right form quickly, the traps are waiting.

Our community

You don't learn alone.

Live speaking clubs every Thursday, your own Student Club in the app, and Farin answering your questions.

Every Thursday

Thursday speaking clubs

One-hour live groups where you speak English or Spanish with people near your level. The app shows you the groups that fit your level, your goals and the topics you love.

Iran time (in Turkey, 30 minutes earlier)

  • 13:00First Words CaféEnglish · A1
  • 14:00First TripEnglish · A1
  • 15:00Work & Study TalkEnglish · A2–B1
  • 16:00Café en españolSpanish · A1–A2
  • 17:00Español para el trabajoSpanish · A1–A2
  • 18:00Everyday ChatEnglish · A2–B1
  • Groups of 8
  • One-hour sessions
  • ₺300 or 500,000 toman a session
  • Free with Guided

Book your seat in the app: Club › My Groups. Pick 1 to 4 Thursdays at a time; the seat is yours once Farin confirms your payment.

Student Club

The Club tab in the bottom bar is your corner: your progress and your speaking groups live there.

Message Farin in the app

Ask anything in the Messages tab: a word, a course, a club seat. Farin usually answers within a day.
